2608.24360.title: Words, Spaces and Generative AI: Layers of language in contemporary architecture
2608.24360.paper_summary: Language can be considered a design material in architecture, and in the context of text-to-X generative AI models becoming a common tool for architectural practice, looking more closely at language is more important now than in the past. After describing some of the important developments in linguistics starting from Wittgenstein, and including the work of Chomsky, Lakoff, conceptual and generative metaphors as proposed by Schön, this chapter connects them to contemporary architectural design and generative text-to-X tools. The chapter builds on the idea that three main forms of language intertwine in architectural design done using generative AI, namely (I) discourse (or natural language which can contain professional terminology specific to our field), (II) programming languages (which are artificial languages sitting at the basis of all computational systems), and (III) annotations (as language elements attached to pieces of data). It concludes by outlining a research agenda for connecting generative metaphors to generative AI: (a) conducting corpus linguistics studies on architectural texts (using quantitative tools such as topic modelling, and qualitative tools such as discourse analysis); (b) bringing communication theory and information studies closer to architectural research and (c) taking into account that different (natural) languages come with different affordances meaning generative and conceptual metaphors differ in relation to this.
2608.24360.paper_summary_zh: 語言可以被視為建築中的設計材料，在文本到 X 的生成 AI 模型成為建築實踐的常用工具的背景下，更加仔細地研究語言現在比以往任何時候都更為重要。<lb/>在描述從維特根斯坦開始的一些重要語言學發展，包括喬姆斯基、拉科夫的研究，以及肖恩提出的概念和生成隱喻之後，本章將其與當代建築設計和生成文本到 X 工具聯繫起來。<lb/>本章基於這樣一個觀點，即三種主要的語言形式在使用生成 AI 進行的建築設計中交織在一起，即 (I) 言談（或自然語言，可能包含我們領域特有的專業術語），(II) 程式語言（這些是所有計算系統的基礎上的人工語言），以及 (III) 註釋（作為附加於數據片段的語言元素）。<lb/>最後，通過概述一個研究議程來將生成隱喻與生成 AI 連接起來： (a) 對建築文本進行語料庫語言學研究（使用主題建模等定量工具，以及話語分析等定性工具）； (b) 使傳播理論和信息研究更接近建築研究；以及 (c) 考慮到不同的（自然）語言具有不同的特性，這意味著生成和概念隱喻在這方面有所不同。
